rationale: First stage reduced negative alarms 94 to4 but selected R88.17%; no joint P80/R90 operating point. Reduce negative sampling2x to1x and lr3e-4 to1e-4 to attempt recall recovery.
selection: Same fixed mixed val and same DeploymentSelection policy; no test evaluation.
promotion_rule: Candidate mixed-val P>=.80 and R>=.90 at calibrated threshold; original 164 positive-val R>=.90 at same threshold; fewer negative-image FPs than baseline at its existing deployment threshold. Report also equal-recall comparison. If gates fail keep existing preview.
scope: Conditional development iteration; stage1 val already observed; no independent acceptance claim. Combined source/sampling/lr change is not isolated causal evidence.
